# CI dependency pins (pen-test close-out F-05, 2026-09-24).
#
# Why pinned: three workflows used to run `pip install pyyaml PySide6 jsonschema`
# with no versions -- builds were not reproducible (the same commit could resolve
# different versions over time) and dependency scanners such as pip-audit had no
# auditable input. Pinning fixes both.
#
# Versions come from the PyPI JSON API `info.version` on 2026-09-24 (latest stable
# that day), not from guessing. Follow-ups are handled by .github/dependabot.yml (pip).
#
# NOTE (important): this file is deliberately **ASCII-only**. pip parses requirements
# files with the *locale* encoding and does not honour a coding cookie, so non-ASCII
# comments break `pip install -r` under non-UTF-8 locales (reproduced on Windows/GBK).
# Keep it ASCII.
#
# Scope: this is the CI toolchain, not NF's own package metadata. NF itself stays
# stdlib-only with soft third-party imports (see purity_scan R5).
pyyaml==6.0.3
PySide6==6.11.2
jsonschema==4.26.0
coverage==7.16.1
